crew_onboarding_step_connect_body: A Linux server you can SSH into, with systemd and sudo. Setup takes about two minutes.
crew_onboarding_step_engine_body: Pick the AI your crewmate will use. Click one to install it on the server and sign in; it takes about a minute and runs on your own subscription or API key.
crew_onboarding_step_how_body: This is what a crewmate does while you're away.
crew_onboarding_step_intro_body: Crewmates are AI agents that work on a server you own.
crew_onboarding_step_intro_bullet_server: Runs on your own Linux server. No account.
crew_onboarding_step_intro_bullet_sleep: Keeps working while this computer sleeps.
crew_onboarding_step_ready_body: Open a chat to send your first task. You can add more crewmates and customize them from the workspace.
